name: Space Radiation
description: Ionizing radiation in space comes from galactic cosmic rays and solar particle events. NASA studies how this exposure affects the human body during exploration missions.

name: Isolation and Confinement
description: Isolation and confinement describe the limited social contact and personal space of long-duration missions. NASA studies how these conditions affect behavior and performance.

name: Distance from Earth
description: Distance from Earth increases communication delay and limits resupply and evacuation. NASA studies how crews manage health and operations with less real-time support.

name: Gravity Fields
description: Gravity fields include microgravity and partial gravity. NASA studies how changes in gravity affect bones, muscles, body fluids, and the cardiovascular system.

name: Hostile Closed Environments
description: Hostile closed environments are spacecraft and habitats with controlled air, water, and temperature. NASA studies how contaminants, equipment failures, and other stressors affect crew health.
